questions.question: In a father's advice to his son about wisdom, why does he say to guard your heart with all diligence?

answers.text: Springs of life flow from it
Others will try to steal it

questions.question: A father tells his son to listen and receive his words. What does the father promise the son?
A father says the path of the righteous is like the first gleam of dawn. What happens to that light?

answers.text: It flickers and then goes out

questions.question: At the end of a father's advice about wisdom, what does he tell his son about the path he walks?

answers.text: Don't stop to rest along it
